The '''Mark X Executioner droid''' was a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] built by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. The tall droid moved on two caterpillar tracks—a dual-tread drive system—and was outfitted with a variety of weapons.

==Characteristics==
[[File:MarkXExecutioner2-FF56.png|thumb|left|180px|A Mark X Executioner forward view]]
The Mark X was among the best gladiator droids in existence. It was armed with a diverse array of weaponry capable of destroying almost any foe, and had heavy armor. Its multiple weapon-arms included a [[Neuronic whip/Legends|neuron whip]], [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]], [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], [[Missile/Legends|missile]] [[Missile launcher/Legends|launcher]], [[Flamethrower/Legends|flame projector]], and a primitive [[Club/Legends|spiked club]].<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars Adventures 6: The Warlords of Balmorra]]''</ref> Galactic customers for whom the droid was in demand included bored dictators and their subjects. The droids were not, of course, invincible and could be destroyed by well-aimed energy bolts or [[Laser/Legends|laser]] scalpels, if used correctly, as shown, on one occasion, by a [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droid]] in a gladiator tournament.

==History==
In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], [[Rigorra]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] deployed three missile-launching and flame-throwing Mark-Xs against [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] in the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord's]] hazardous subterranean "Impromptu Semiannual Balmorra Death Run" competition. Other captured bounty hunters who participated in the compulsory contest included [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], and [[Skorr/Legends|Skorr]]. Because Fett was already familiar with the gladiator droid's vulnerable spot—the small underside patch that lay between the treads, where the droid's external cooling circuitry was located—he was able to cripple all three Mark-Xs with strategically aimed energy bolts. The areas between the Executioner droids' treads exploded, bringing them down.<ref name=":0" />

[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Rom Mohc]] defeated a Mark X Executioner in single combat, and kept its remains in his trophy room.<ref name="Dark">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref>

[[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]] [[Mirkovig Hirken]] of [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] owned a Mark-X, and often pitted it against other droids in combat at his prison.

While traveling with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the droid [[BLX-5|Bollux]] was one of the Mark-X's opponents. Bollux defeated the Mark-X by outsmarting it, with help from fellow droid [[Blue Max]].
